== History ==
Its founding year is unknown. According to ''Awa Gunshi'', "During the Bun'an era, the local lord Harada Yamato-no-kami lamented its ruin and repaired the shrine buildings, also dedicating one sacred mirror as a treasure," suggesting the shrine had already declined in the {{ill|Muromachi period|ar|فترة موروماتشي|ast|Periodu Muromachi|bcl|Panahon nin Muromachi|be|Перыяд Мурамаці|bg|Муромачи|bn|মুরোমাচি যুগ|ceb|Panahon sa Muromachi|ckb|سەردەمی مرۆماچی|cs|Období Muromači|de|Muromachi-Zeit|eo|Epoko de Muromaĉi|es|Período Muromachi|eu|Muromachi aroa|fa|دوره موروماچی|fi|Muromachi-kausi|fr|Époque de Muromachi|gl|Período Muromachi|he|תקופת אשיקאגה|hu|Muromacsi-kor|id|Zaman Muromachi|ilo|Panahon ti Muromachi|it|Periodo Muromachi|ja|室町時代|kk|Муромачи кезеңі|ko|무로마치 시대|lt|Muromači laikotarpis|nl|Muromachiperiode|pl|Muromachi (okres)|pt|Período Muromachi|ru|Период Муромати|simple|Muromachi period|sk|Obdobie Muromači|sl|Obdobje Muromači|sr|Муромачи период|sv|Ashikaga|th|ยุคมูโรมาจิ|tl|Panahong Muromachi|tr|Muromachi Dönemi|uk|Період Муроматі|vi|Thời kỳ Muromachi|wuu|室町时代|zh|室町时代|zh_min_nan|Muromati sî-tāi|zh_yue|室町時代|qid=Q334845}} and was later revived.

It is one of the candidate shrines for Takefutsu Shrine listed in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|abstract|Q11064932|fr|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|simple|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|zh|延喜式神名帳|qid=Q11064932}}; the other candidate is {{ill|Takefutsu Shrine|ja|建布都神社|qid=Q48758365}} in {{ill|Ichiba-chō Kami|ja|市場町香美|qid=Q47393149}}, Awa City. It was once also called Sugiō-sha.

Nishinomiya Shrine is said to have been founded by {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Harada Magoshirō}}, lord of Kōri Castle, who invited a divided spirit of {{ill|Kotoshironushi-no-Mikoto|fa|کوتوشیرونوشی|fr|Kotoshironushi|it|Kotoshironushi|ja|事代主|ko|고토시로누시|ru|Котосиронуси|simple|Kotoshironushi|th|โคโตชิโรนูชิ|zh|事代主神|qid=Q8009611|lt=Kotoshironushi-no-Mikoto}} from {{ill|Izumo-taisha|abstract|Q696362|ar|إزومو-تايشا|cs|Svatyně Izumo|de|Izumo-Taisha|es|Izumo Taisha|eu|Izumo-taisha|fi|Izumo-taisha|fr|Izumo-taisha|gl|Izumo Taisha|he|איזומו טאיישה|hu|Izumo-taisa|id|Izumo Taisha|it|Santuario di Izumo|ja|出雲大社|jv|Izumo Taisha|ka|იძუმო-ტაიშა|ko|이즈모 대사|la|Izumo-taisha|mk|Изумо-тајша|or|ଇଜୁମୋ ତାଇଶା|pl|Izumo-taisha|pt|Santuário de Izumo|ro|Marele Sanctuar de la Izumo|ru|Идзумо тайся|simple|Izumo-taisha|th|ศาลเจ้าอิซูโมะ|tr|Izumo-taisha|uk|Святилище Ідзумо|wuu|出云大社|zh|出雲大社|qid=Q696362}}.

The crest of Takefutsu Shrine is "crossed sword in a circle," while the crest of Nishinomiya Shrine is {{ill|vine gashiwa in a circle|ja|三つ柏|qid=Q65247832|lt=vine gashiwa in a circle}}.
